title: General progress substitutes for specific training data in language models
abstract: arXiv:2611.24844v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Language models acquire their capabilities from training data, and developers withhold data during training to keep models from learning capabilities that could be misused. How long this delays a capability, and how much data is needed to acquire it later, is unknown. Here we show that the general progress a model makes on the rest of its training data substitutes for the data that was withheld. We withheld the training signal for individual skills in models of chess, Othello, molecular strings, bracket languages and web text. The delay of a withheld skill in larger models was predicted from smaller ones. A chess model never explicitly trained to respond to check ranked the legal responses almost as well as a model that was. When models were then trained on the withheld data, they acquired the skill with a small fraction of the data needed from initialization, and this fraction decreased as the models progressed. translated_title: 语言模型中的整体进步可替代特定训练数据
translated_abstract: 语言模型从训练数据中获得其能力，开发者在训练期间扣留数据以防止模型学习可能被滥用的能力。这种做法会延迟一项能力多久，以及之后获取该能力需要多少数据，目前尚不清楚。在这里，我们展示了模型在其余训练数据上取得的总体进步可以替代被扣留的数据。我们在国际象棋、黑白棋、分子字符串、括号语言和网页文本的模型中扣留了单个技能的训练信号。被扣留技能在较大模型中的延迟程度可以从小模型的表现中预测得出。一个从未被明确训练过应对将军局面的国际象棋模型，对合法应对着法的排序几乎与受过训练的模型一样好。当模型随后在被扣留的数据上进行训练时，它们只需从初始状态训练所需数据量的一小部分即可习得该技能，而且这一比例随着模型训练的进展而降低。
tldr: 该论文发现，语言模型在其余训练数据上取得的整体进步能够替代被刻意扣留的特定训练数据——模型只需从零开始所需数据量的一小部分即可习得此前被扣留的技能，且所需数据量随模型训练进展而不断减少。
en_tdlr: General progress a language model makes on the rest of its training data substitutes for deliberately withheld data, allowing withheld skills to be acquired later with only a small fraction of the data needed from initialization.
